method: per-net coupling ratio Cc/(Cc+Cg) from the REAL OpenRCX SPEF. max_crosstalk_noise = max_ratio*Vdd is the worst-case capacitive-divider (FLOATING-victim) UPPER bound — advisory; a driven victim sees far less. Coupling-dominated (>0.90) nets are a watch-list, NOT proven failures: a full SI sign-off needs timing-window + driver-strength analysis (commercial SI tool).
